definitions.explanation: The professional or personal care of sick, injured, or disabled people. Includes both medical nursing and family caregiving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{看護|かんご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took time off to nurse my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying to become a nurse.

examples.japanese: {入院中|にゅういんちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{看護|かんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたり、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そばにいて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: During my hospital stay, family members took turns nursing me, and someone was always by my side every day.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({看護|かんご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to nurse, to care for) or as a noun modifier ({看護|かんご}{師|し} = nurse). The most common compound is ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧ (nurse), which replaced the older gender-specific terms ⟦{看護婦|かんごふ}→看護婦：01380_kangofu⟧ (female nurse) and {看護士|かんごし} (male nurse) in 2002.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧: nurse
- {看護|かんご}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: nursing school
- {看護|かんご}{学部|がくぶ}: nursing faculty/department
- {看護|かんご}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: nursing records
- ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧{看護|かんご}: home nursing care
- {看護|かんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる: to provide nursing care

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{漢語|かんご}→漢語：13439_kango⟧: Chinese-origin word (linguistic term, different meaning)
